text: I did it. I killed the one that they all call Mama…but I couldn't carry out her wish. If I destroyed the core, there's no way I could've gone back to the spacecraft alive. They'll send out another operative. I assume that you're reading this now. If you've taken the same journey that I have, you'll understand my sympathy for these robots. I've hidden the core in a safe space in the factory. Destroy it or bring it back to the spacecraft. I don't care. This assignment has been far too taxing and I want to go home.
